**Big, but not everywhere.** 94 files, ~1082 hits.

Three spots must keep `account_id`:

| Where | Why |
|---|---|
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | public wire field, frozen by `docs/openapi.yaml` |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | vendored, generated, do not edit |
| `migrations/*.sql` | applied history, renaming breaks the down step |

Next: rename freely in `services/*` and repos, leave those three.
